title: Yellowed Brown Uruguayan Beef Skewers
description: A bitter and juicy Uruguayan dish featuring Marmite, perfect for midnight cravings, this egg-free-friendly recipe is air-fried to perfection, offering a unique flavor experience.
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Mix Marmite, olive oil, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika in a bowl.
Add the beef strips to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the marinated beef strips onto skewers.
Place the skewers in the air fryer basket and cook for 10 minutes.
Shake the basket halfway through cooking.
Brush the beef with lemon juice during the last minute of cooking.
Remove the skewers from the air fryer and let them rest for a few minutes.
